title: Dedicated worker realm with typed message boundary

expectedResults.expectation: new Worker(new URL("./worker.ts", import.meta.url), { type: "module" }) resolves a dedicated-worker realm separate from the main realm
the postMessage payload narrows to WorkerRequest and the reply event to WorkerReply across the realm boundary through the TypeScript projection rail
a comparison against a kind other than ping inside the narrowed branch is flagged as an impossible comparison, not silently accepted
executing code inside the worker realm requires explicit trust and a permission grant through the execution-intent surface; nothing executes by default
